systems.name: Body & shell
systems.description: The 992 uses one wide body for every variant, with flared rear arches, a full-width light bar and active aerodynamics. The Turbo S adds larger front intakes and its own exhaust.
systems.principle: A mixed steel and aluminium structure with mostly aluminium outer panels to save weight. Active aero: front air flaps and a rear wing that rises with speed.

systems.name: Glass & lights
systems.description: Windshield, frameless door glass and a rear window hugging the tail. Matrix LED headlights and the full-width tail light strip mark the 992.
systems.principle: Frameless windows seal against rubber and drop slightly when a door opens. The headlights dim individual segments so oncoming drivers are not dazzled.

systems.name: Doors & lids
systems.description: Two long doors with powered pop-out handles, a front luggage lid and a rear engine lid with the integrated wing. The source model is posed with the left door open to show the interior.
systems.principle: Handles sit flush and extend when the car unlocks. The front lid covers a 128-litre luggage compartment; the rear lid covers the engine and carries the active spoiler.

systems.name: Cockpit
systems.description: A 2+2 cockpit with 18-way sport seats, an analogue rev counter between two screens, a 10.9-inch centre display and the horizontal dashboard of classic 911s. The source model includes the full interior.
systems.principle: The 911 layout: a small wheel, a short PDK selector and a start switch to the left. Leather, carbon and brushed aluminium; the rear seats carry luggage more often than people.

systems.name: Twin-turbo flat-six
systems.description: A 3.8-litre water-cooled flat-six with two symmetrical variable-geometry turbochargers, mounted behind the rear axle.
systems.principle: The two turbos spin in opposite directions and vary their turbine vane angle for quick response at low revs and full boost at high revs. Radiators sit in the nose with coolant lines along the floor.

systems.name: PDK & all-wheel drive
systems.description: An eight-speed PDK dual-clutch gearbox sits ahead of the engine; a propshaft runs the length of the car to the front axle for active all-wheel drive.
systems.principle: Two clutches swap gears in tens of milliseconds. Porsche Traction Management sends torque forward through an electronically controlled multi-plate clutch as soon as the rear wheels begin to slip.

systems.name: Fuel tank
systems.description: A 67-litre tank in the nose, ahead of the luggage compartment, balancing the rear-mounted engine.
systems.principle: The 911 tradition: fuel at the front, engine at the back. A high-pressure pump feeds the direct-injection system.

systems.name: PASM suspension
systems.description: MacPherson front and multi-link rear suspension, electronically controlled PASM dampers lowered by 10 mm, and rear-axle steering as standard on the Turbo S.
systems.principle: Sensors read body motion hundreds of times a second and adjust the damper valves. The rear wheels steer opposite the fronts at low speed for agility and with them at high speed for stability.

systems.name: PCCB ceramic brakes
systems.description: Carbon-ceramic composite brakes as standard: 420 mm discs at the front, 390 mm at the rear, with the signature yellow ten-piston front calipers. Discs and calipers here come from the source mesh.
systems.principle: Ceramic discs weigh about half as much as steel and tolerate far higher temperatures, cutting unsprung mass and resisting fade under repeated hard stops.

systems.name: Wheels
systems.description: Staggered wheels: 20 inches at the front, 21 at the rear, with 315 mm rear tyres to put 800 Nm on the road.
systems.principle: Wider rear tyres match the rear-biased weight distribution. Centre-lock wheels are available in racing style.

pieces.door: The 992's long frameless door. The source model poses the left door open to reveal the interior; the right door is closed.
pieces.disc: Porsche Ceramic Composite Brake disc from the source mesh: 420 mm at the front, 390 mm at the rear, with the signature yellow calipers.

notes: Figures for the 911 Turbo S (992) from 2020. Model by n.brizitskaya with a full interior; the left door is posed open.
